image_description: A close-up, top-down view of two feet wearing colorful, hand-knitted wool socks. The socks feature a variegated yarn with horizontal stripes of red, orange, blue, purple, and green. The left sock shows a standard ribbed cuff, while the right sock has a decorative scalloped or picot edge at the top. The texture is visibly fuzzy and fibrous, characteristic of wool. The background appears to be dark leather upholstery.
